summary_en: TMH Inc. authorized acquisition of up to 55,000 shares (1.47% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 50 million yen through on-exchange purchases from October 26 to December 25, 2026, to support capital efficiency, shareholder returns, and an employee restricted stock award program.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
TMH Inc.'s Board of Directors resolved on October 23, 2026, to acquire up to 55,000 shares of its common stock (representing 1.47% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) at a maximum expenditure of 50 million yen. The acquisition will be conducted through on-exchange purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from October 26 to December 25, 2026.

The company stated three purposes for this buyback program: improving capital efficiency in response to changing business conditions, returning capital to shareholders, and securing treasury shares to be allocated under its restricted stock award program for officers and employees. The restricted stock awards are designed to enhance the sense of belonging and management engagement among participants.
